description:
Job Description 
 A consultative mindset and ability to understand
 client needs and recommend appropriate solutions

 Recent experience with design, implementation and
 operations of IaaS & PaaS solutions and/or Application
 modernization, migration and development on PaaS
 platforms.

 8+ years experience in enterprise software development

 Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
 are required

 Ability to see and present "the big picture" and offer
 solutions to make it better

 Strong customer facing and relationship building
 skills

 Must be effective in working both independently and in
 a team setting

 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field

 

 Skills 

 

 Must to have : 

 1. Core Java 

 2. Spring MVC / core 

 3. JPA

 4. Restful webservices

 5. Jquery 

 6. Oracle - sql/ plsql 

 7. Messaging - queue and topics 

 8. Html,CSS

 9. SSL - 2 way

 10. Spring Security 

 

 
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
